body_html:
The Luray executive chair brings boardroom presence to the everyday office — ample proportions, full back support and refined upholstered detailing that holds up through the longest meeting days. The polished aluminum arm can be finished with a urethane or solid-wood top cap, and contrasting stitch detail lets you match it to a wide range of Global textiles and quality leathers. It is a confident, well-scaled executive chair built for offices that do real work.

Features

  • Available in three back heights — mid, high and extended (executive) — with horizontal sewing details.
  • Choice of two mechanisms: a tilter or knee-tilter to suit how you sit.
  • Soft Descent pneumatic lift lowers the seat slowly and gently so you land at the exact height you want.
  • Polished aluminum arm specified with a urethane or solid-wood top cap.
  • Discrete edge stitching on seat and back, with matched thread standard and contrasting stitching available.
  • Upholstered in your choice of Global textile or quality leather covering.

Specifications

Overall dimensions W25 x D26.5 x H42.5–46 in across the high-back and extended high-back models, rated for users up to 300 lbs in single-shift use. GREENGUARD (Level 2) certified and ANSI/BIFMA compliant. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and components, 12 years on control mechanisms and 5 years on upholstery, foam and mesh. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group.

Family-owned since 1964 and based at 296 George St N, Peterborough ON, Brant Business Interiors is an OECM-eligible supplier — Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote for volume pricing and finish options, or call 1-800-835-9565.
